npc.title: Evolution Item Seller (New)
lines: Location: Snowpoint City
The top left house is now occupied by an NPC who will sell evolution items to you.
She only sells items that are not available in the Veilstone Dept. Store or the Game Corner.
One of any item will cost you $10,000.

npc.title: Item Fanatic (New)
lines: Location: Floaroma Town
The house to the right of the Pokémon Center contains the "Item Fanatic".
Talk to him and he'll mention that he can give you items only particular Pokémon can use.
Talk to him with a Pikachu in your party to get a Light Ball.
Talk to him with a Farfetch'd in your party to get a Stick.
Talk to him with a Cubone or Marowak in your party to get a Thick Club.
Talk to him with a Chansey in your party to get a Lucky Punch.
Talk to him with a Ditto in your party to get a Quick Powder and Metal Powder.
Talk to him with a Clamperl in your party to get a Deep Sea Tooth and Deep Sea Scale.

npc.title: Move Deleter
lines: Location: Oreburgh City
The move deleter has moved into the house left of the Pokémon Center in Oreburgh City.
No other changes.

npc.title: Move Relearner
lines: Location: Pastoria City
The move relearner is in the same place as before.
Heart Scales or any payment is no longer required - just speak to him to learn some moves.

npc.title: Move Tutors
lines: Location: Route 212 (South)
The move tutors from Route 212, Snowpoint City and the Survival Area are now all present in the house on Route 212.
Shards or any payment is no longer required - just speak to them to learn a move.

npc.title: Rare Berry Seller (New)
lines: Location: Route 208
The house just left of the gatehouse to Hearthome City where the Berry Master lives now has a female scientist NPC.
This NPC will sell you rare berries that can't be obtained in Platinum normally, such as the Liechi and Salac Berries.
Each berry can be bought infinite times but will cost $10,000 per purchase.

npc.title: Fish Lure guy (Super Rod guy)
lines: Location: Snowpoint City
The top right house in Snowpoint City is now the location of the Fish Lure guy.
He previously gave you the Super Rod, and was located in the Fight Area.

faq.question: Q: Why is the patching not working?
answer: Make sure you're using the correct Platinum ROM. It should be listed as Revision 1, Rev 1, or the dump with the number listed as 4997 or 4998. The 3541 one does not work for this hack.
Make sure you're trying to apply the patch to an .nds file (that should be 128 MB). It should not still be compressed in a .zip or .7z, and it definitely should not be an .exe!
If you are on Mac, consider using a program called MultiPatch instead (easy to find on Google). The Delta Patcher Lite tool will probably not work for you.
Patching is a bit unreliable on mobile phones. I can't really help with problems there.

faq.question: Q: Why has my game frozen when trying to start the first rival battle?
answer: This means you've likely used the wrong ROM base. Most websites have the correct Platinum dump listed as 4997 or 4998.
There is an earlier copy listed as 3541 - this will not work.
If you try to force the patch through by unchecking "checksum validation" in Delta Patcher Lite, you will probably also end up with this issue.
If you have the correct ROM base, you won't need to uncheck the "checksum validation".

faq.question: Q: How can I update my Altered Platinum to a newer version?
answer: Altered Platinum save files are compatible between each version, so this should be possible.
Most emulators link the ROM name and the save file together, e.g. AlteredPlatinum.nds would have a corresponding save file AlteredPlatinum.sav.
Please note I am referring to battery (normal) saves here done by the save menu in game. ** Save states will NOT work if you change the ROM version! **
First, get an .nds copy of the newest Altered Platinum. The patch must always be applied to a vanilla Platinum ROM.

subsections.title: Export / Import Battery Saves (DeSmuME)
lines: If using DeSmuME, you can export your current battery save by going to File -> Export Backup Memory in DeSmuME to produce a .sav file. Do this while playing the old Altered Platinum with your current save file loaded.
Open the new ROM, then do File -> Import Backup Memory and select the .sav you just exported. Your save file should now be active.

subsections.title: The Filename Switch Method
lines: Rename the new version of the Altered Platinum ROM have the same filename as whatever your now old version file is.

For example, if you were playing AlteredPlatinumX.nds on your emulator, and your new version is now AlteredPlatinumY.nds, you could rename that newer version from AlteredPlatinumY.nds -> AlteredPlatinumX.nds.
Replace your old ROM with the new ROM.
Boot up the new ROM on the emulator and hopefully your save file should be there.

Please note that if you are updating from v1.0.0, v1.0.1, v1.0.2 or v1.0.3 to any newer version while keeping your save file, you will need to talk to the NPC found in any of the Pokémon Centers in Jubilife, Eterna, Hearthome or Veilstone to get everything in place in your save.

faq.question: Q: Can I randomise Altered Platinum?
answer: No, this is not possible via the Universal Pokémon Randomizer.
Expanded files mean the internal file locations are different to normal, and the Universal Pokémon Randomizer is unable to handle this.
This is impossible to add support for.

faq.question: Q: Can I get <Pokémon name here> as a shiny?
answer: Yes, all Pokémon are available as shiny at the new shiny rate(1/512).
You need to soft reset to try to get shinies for static encounters; save states don't reroll the RNG so you'll get the same Pokémon every time.

faq.question: Q: I'm seeing graphical distortion when walking in grass sometimes. Is this a bug?
answer: This is a bug, but not with the hack; it's a problem with the emulator (specifically DeSmuME that I know of).
The graphical distortion is harmless and will go away when the screen is refreshed.
This problem also happens with the original Platinum.

faq.question: Q: I finished the Galactic events in Eterna City and am now stuck. What do I do?
answer: Go to the Bike Shop in Eterna City and talk to the owner. After this, you should be able to progress past Route 206.

faq.question: Q: Why can't I get into Canalave City? Where am I meant to go?
answer: You must now visit Pal Park before you can continue into Canalave City.
Be sure to talk to all of the NPCs at Pal Park. You're after a specific item to get past the guard blocking you!

faq.question: Q: Where can I find the ROM base for Altered Platinum?
answer: Can't give you a link here, unfortunately. But they do exist on the Internet.

actionReplay.title: General
lines: These are some Action Replay codes which might be helpful to make the game play a bit faster.
Please note that the Game ID is different to the original Platinum. You can find this value out with the R4 Cheat Code Editor program if you need it.

actionReplay.title: Instant Text
lines: This code will make all text appear instantly instead of a gradual scroll.
Please note that it will stop you hearing certain fanfares (e.g. the sound effect after an evolution).

actionReplay.title: Gauge Animation Cut
lines: This code will make it so HP bars drop instantly instead of gradually.
Please note that it won't have any effect until the HP bars are over a certain value, so the effect won't be immediately apparent early on.
